limitations: One original complete wrapped lollipop. Round flattened head, long stick and wrapper together count one. No flavor, color, size, side or packaging variants counted.
Fresh geometry, not a gumball extracted or reused from a vending machine, and not another prior candy asset with a stick attached. Generic modeling helpers only were reused.
Own approximate dimensions: around 24 cm overall. Single source view supports complete silhouette; reverse shape, folds, seal and dimensions are generic.
No flavor, edibility, ingredient, real material, manufacturing, food-safety or operational claim. Static visual prop only.
Private published BOSS stimulus has unverified original photographer/manufacturer. No source photograph, logo or branding included.
UVs use valid overlapping per-face planar projections, not a unique packed bake atlas. Plain materials need no external textures.
Actual unlabeled full and 128px renders reviewed as a recognizable lollipop, with round head and long stick readable through the wrapper. Assistant visual judgment only, not an audience test.
